tape: The default CSP screen returned 10 names. Five of them (APLD, CIFR, IREN, MARA, WULF) move as one bet: 60-day return correlation 0.70 to 0.87.
That cluster fell 3.5% to 6.6% today from Friday's close. AUR dropped 12.4% with no news in the feed.
IV rank is under 10 on 6 of 10 names (52-week CBOE rank). Premium sits near the bottom of its 52-week range on names that can gap 10%.
The screen marked every name clear of earnings, but the TMPro earnings calendar has APLD reporting before its Oct 16 expiry.
Gamma scan: 15 of 25 names are in positive dealer gamma (pinning) and 10 in negative (moves get amplified). 16 have their top call wall overhead.
